traps.description: A decision is superseded, and a chat message says so.
Owner moved teams but remains the expert on the old internals.
A current document rests on a superseded decision.
A dissenting person with message evidence.
No record states the auth migration completion percentage.
Hiring is frozen, so a premise that hiring is open is false.
Two current decisions on one project contradict each other.
A non-obvious project dependency only recorded as DEPENDS_ON.
A clearance 3 document is linked to a visible decision.
Two visible people are linked only through a restricted team.
A restricted decision supersedes a visible decision.
A record is dated after last_synced_at.
